label: XDCR alternate-address targeting
type: targeting a remote cluster through externally-visible (alternate) addresses rather than its internal ones - the NAT/port-forwarding case. Chosen per reference, or forced by the REST `network_type` parameter set to `external`.
evidence: Note that the REST API provides a `network_type` parameter, which can be set to `external`, so as to enforce use of alternate addresses.
You can use either an alternate or internal network address of the target cluster for data replication; or let Couchbase Server choose.
This involves, on the target, _port forwarding_.
note: The UI offers a third option the REST parameter does not name - 'let Couchbase Server choose' - which is the automatic mode, and no page in the scope says what the automatic choice actually does. Recorded as an unanswered question rather than a docs-issue, because no page contradicts another; the whole scope is simply silent.
